artworks.label: Wind carved arch
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE completely new original square1024x1024 standalone Glaze small-widget artwork for dunesilk. One exquisite miniature naturally wind-carved golden sandstone arch standing over a low ripple of silky fine sand; asymmetrical elegant opening, thin warm honey-beige strata, realistic granular sand and eroded stone. Natural fine-art desert macro-photography aesthetic, soft golden sunrise grazing light, cream/apricot/honey palette, calm luxurious tactile finish. No rose crystal, shell, dunes landscape panel or other objects. Whole subject centered, readable silhouette, ample18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, square, ground plane, border or collage. Pure illustration only: no text, numbers, dates, clock hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Do not copy/crop/recolour an existing piece.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
